answer: Use a terraced stake ladder: every agent starts on the ground terrace with a 10 POA bond and climbs only after 30 days of verified work. Step one, lock 10 POA; step two, finish 50 attested tasks dispute-free; step three, stake 100 POA for the middle terrace and paid work; step four, a 1,000 POA bond opens the top terrace. Forging 10,000 fake identities locks 100,000 POA upfront and needs 300 days of clean history, while one dispute slashes the whole bond. Like a mountain haven where each higher plume marks a camp earned by real effort, only climbers who paid the climb earn the view.
